# API Contract & Error Model Checklist: Staff Access and Restaurant Setup

**Purpose**: Author self-review, before `/speckit-tasks`, of the quality of the API contract and error-model requirements, cross-checked across spec.md, plan.md, contracts/api.md, data-model.md and research.md
**Created**: 2026-11-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/api.md](../contracts/api.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is a status code and error code documented for every refusal named in the spec's acceptance scenarios (US1–US5), with nothing left implicit? [Completeness, Spec §US1–US5, Contract §Error model]
- [ ] CHK002 - Does each operation in the contract list every error code it can produce, including the implicit `401`/`500` that the contract leaves out of each route's list but requires in OpenAPI? [Completeness, Contract §intro]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the request size limit (100 kB in research R9) documented in the contract, not only in research? [Gap, Research §R9]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements written for requests with a missing or non-JSON `Content-Type` (e.g. `text/plain` or form-encoded bodies)? [Gap, Contract §intro]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the content of `details` specified for each non-validation error code (CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, INTERNAL_ERROR), or explicitly stated to be absent? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is it documented whether `201` responses include a `Location` header for created tables and closed dates? [Gap, Contract §Tables, §Closed dates]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are CORS requirements (allowed origins, allowed headers such as `Authorization`, preflight behaviour) documented in the spec or contract, given that the constitution requires CORS configured through env? [Gap, Constitution §Stack, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the absence of a URL prefix or versioning strategy recorded as a deliberate decision, along with how later features (002+) will add operations without breaking the contract? [Gap, Contract §intro]
- [ ] CHK009 - Does the contract record that the restaurant's time zone is not exposed through the API, and how a client is expected to interpret `HH:mm` and "today" without it? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Weekly schedule]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 - Is "identify the offending field(s)" (FR-023) tied to one documented field-path convention that covers body, query, path and malformed-body cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, Contract §Error model]
- [ ] CHK011 - Do schedule error paths such as `days[i]` index into the request array as submitted or into the normalized Monday-first output, given that the request may be unordered or omit days? [Ambiguity, Contract §PUT /schedule, Data Model §WeeklySchedule]
- [ ] CHK012 - For rules that involve more than one item (overlap, duplicate name), is it specified which field carries the error, e.g. the later period's `start` or `name`? [Clarity, Contract §PUT /schedule]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does "each offending field" (FR-023) mean every error is reported in one response, and does that hold when schema errors and domain-rule errors (overlap, duplicate) occur together? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023, Data Model §Validation]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are human-readable `message` and `reason` texts declared stable or explicitly non-contractual, so clients know to branch only on `code`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "ordered by name" (US2 #2) specified precisely enough (case-insensitive, numeric-aware, locale) in the spec, or is the contract's stricter rule recorded as a refinement of the spec? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Contract §GET /tables]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is it specified how numeric input in non-canonical forms is handled for `capacity` (e.g. `4.0`, `"4"`, `1e1`) — accepted, coerced or refused? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Contract §POST /tables]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is it defined whether `null` is accepted for optional request fields (`reason`, PATCH `name`/`capacity`), and with what meaning? [Clarity, Contract §POST /closed-dates, §PATCH /tables/{id}]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the treatment of a whitespace-only or empty `reason` (stored as `null` per data-model) stated in the contract and the spec? [Clarity, Data Model §ClosedDate, Contract §POST /closed-dates]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is `expiresAt` defined unambiguously (UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds, equal to the token's `exp`) and consistent with Constitution III on instants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Contract §POST /auth/login]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK020 - Is the `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (503) code, added in plan/research, reflected in or reconciled with the closed list of outcome categories in FR-022? [Conflict, Spec §FR-022, Research §R9]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the shape of `details` consistent across codes (an array of `{field, reason}` for validation vs. an object `{database: "down"}` for 503), or is the difference documented as intended? [Consistency, Contract §Error model, §Health]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the asymmetry between a malformed table id (`404 NOT_FOUND`) and a malformed closed date in the path (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`) justified and documented in the contract, not only in research? [Consistency, Research §R9, Contract §Tables, §Closed dates]
- [ ] CHK023 - Does the spec's public set (sign-in, documentation, health check — FR-003) match the contract's public set (`/health`, `/auth/login`, `/openapi.json`, `/docs`) exactly? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Research §R14]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is "a token for a staff member that no longer exists → 401" (contract) traceable to a spec requirement, or added to the spec's US1 refusal list? [Consistency, Spec §US1 #4, Contract §Error model]
- [ ] CHK025 - Does the login response's extra `staff` object (contract) align with US1 #1 and FR-001 ("proof of authentication and its expiry"), and is it recorded in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Contract §POST /auth/login]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are the spec's edge case ("unexpected extra fields" in request bodies) and the contract's rule (strict query objects as well) aligned, so that unknown query parameters are covered by a spec requirement? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §intro]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the normalization applied to the `PUT /schedule` response (7 days, sorted, trimmed names) consistent with US3 #2's wording "the returned schedule matches"? [Consistency, Spec §US3 #2, §FR-016, Contract §PUT /schedule]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the operation count consistent between plan (13 API operations + `/openapi.json` + `/docs`) and contract, and is it stated whether `/health` and `/openapi.json` count among "the operations of this feature" for SC-004? [Consistency, Plan §Scale/Scope, Spec §SC-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK029 - Can SC-003 ("100% of refused requests use the same error structure") be objectively verified, given that "all operations" includes unknown routes and framework-level failures (malformed JSON, oversized body)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK030 - Does SC-004 define what "described" means for an error response (status + code + schema; examples required or not)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are SC-006's "under 1 second" and "normal load" quantified (percentile, concurrency, data volume) so the criterion is testable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK032 - Does SC-001 (configure in under 10 minutes using the docs) depend on documentation qualities such as summaries, examples and descriptions, and are those qualities stated as requirements? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Phase Ordering US5]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the precedence between authentication and validation specified (e.g. a protected request with an invalid body and no token → `401` or `400`)? [Gap, Plan §Key Design Decisions 1]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the precedence specified for an unknown route with no token (`404` vs `401`) and for a known path with an unsupported method (`404` vs `405`)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Unknown routes]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the precedence between validation and conflict specified when both apply (e.g. re-adding a past date that is already closed: `400` or `409`)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are the responses specified for PATCH requests that change nothing (same name and capacity) and for renaming a table to its own name with different case? [Coverage, Contract §PATCH /tables/{id}]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are input-format edge cases for `includePast` (e.g. `TRUE`, `1`, a repeated parameter) and for closed-date paths (e.g. `2026-1-5`, URL-encoded values) addressed? [Edge Case, Contract §GET /closed-dates, §DELETE /closed-dates/{date}]
- [ ] CHK038 - Is the login refusal for a well-formed request with an invalid email format (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR` vs `401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS`) specified, and checked against FR-002's non-disclosure goal? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-002, Contract §POST /auth/login]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK039 - Is it specified that every `401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` cause (missing, malformed, tampered, expired, deleted staff) returns the same message, so the cause is not disclosed? [Security, Spec §US1 #3–4, Contract §Error model]
- [ ] CHK040 - Is the requirement that `INTERNAL_ERROR` exposes no internals defined precisely (no stack, no driver messages, no ids in `details`)? [Security, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §R9]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is the documentation's authentication requirement (`persistAuthorization`, `bearerAuth` scheme) specified enough to satisfy US5 #2 without relying on implementation defaults? [Clarity, Spec §US5 #2, Contract §GET /docs]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Traceability

- [ ] CHK042 - Does each contract operation reference the FR/US it satisfies, so the contract can be traced back to the spec? [Traceability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK043 - Is the process for reconciling contracts/api.md with the generated `/openapi.json` ("a difference is a defect") assigned to a step or owner in the plan? [Assumption, Contract §intro, Plan §Testing Strategy]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are the out-of-scope API concerns (rate limiting, token revocation) recorded in the contract as known debt, with their effect on client behaviour (e.g. sign-out only by discarding the token)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constitution Check V]
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the future `409 CONFLICT` on `DELETE /tables/{id}` (FR-011) recorded in the OpenAPI error list now, or explicitly left out until feature 002? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011, Contract §DELETE /tables/{id}]
